nodes.summary: For an integer $d$, the Gauss class number $h(d)$ is the number of integer triples $(a, b, c)$ with $b^2 - 4ac = d$ for which the binary quadratic form $ax^2 + bxy + cy^2$ is positive definite ($a > 0$ and $d < 0$), reduced ($|b| \le a \le c$, with $b \ge 0$ whenever $|b| = a$ or $a = c$) and primitive ($\gcd(a, b, c) = 1$).

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $F_e(n)$ is the sum of the weights of the reduced positive-definite integral binary quadratic forms $ax^2 + bxy + cy^2$ of discriminant $b^2 - 4ac = -4n$ in which $a$ and $c$ are both even. Here a form is reduced when $|b| \le a \le c$, with $b \ge 0$ whenever $|b| = a$ or $a = c$, and its weight is $1/2$ if $a = c$ and $b = 0$, $1/3$ if $a = b = c$, and $1$ otherwise.

nodes.summary: For an integer $d$, $R(d)$ is the finite set of integer triples $(a, b, c)$ such that the binary quadratic form $a x^2 + b x y + c y^2$ is Gauss reduced (that is, $a > 0$, $b^2 - 4ac < 0$, $|b| \le a \le c$, and $b \ge 0$ whenever $|b| = a$ or $a = c$) and has discriminant $b^2 - 4ac = d$. In particular $R(d)$ is empty when $d \ge 0$.

nodes.title: Unweighted Hurwitz class numbers via Gauss class numbers

nodes.summary: For an integer $d$, the unweighted Hurwitz class number $H(d)$ is the number of elements of the set $R(d)$ of reduced forms of discriminant $d$, that is, the number of integer triples $(a, b, c)$, primitive or not, for which $a x^2 + b x y + c y^2$ is a Gauss-reduced binary quadratic form of discriminant $b^2 - 4ac = d$. Every reduced form is counted with weight $1$; in particular $H(d) = 0$ when $d \ge 0$.

can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
